title: CWSM Plus VS Horror Mods
description: The Wither Storm Vs Horror Mods!
body:
# **Crackers Wither Storm faces up against horror mods and a World Eater goes up against World Corrupters!**

Allocate AT LEAST 4 GB of RAM and some mods are turned off by default, only enable some if you've got a Beefy PC/Device, and if adding other mods be careful as some mods in the modpack are sensitive to somethings and can crash the game if you add something that conflicts with another mod in this modpack but if you want you can disable either. This is prioritised for you and your friends best experience.

### Versions ONLY available for Forge and Neoforge
### (1.20.1)

_Be wary that The Broken Script mod used in this pack is v1.9.3 which is completely fine for your computer unlike the v1.9 version that would shutdown your pc but it can disable nearly all commands except for its own config command and the /TBS_devmode command, if you have command configs (e.g. /[Mod Name] config [Blah blah blah]) for a mod you added or theres one for the mods in my modpack, there is a way to bypass this with either the correct TBS Dev Mode code or using NBT Explorer_

_DO NOT USE 2018 FOR THE TBS DEVMODE CODE, IT CRASHES YOUR GAME WITH 1,000 CIRCUITS, THOUGH IN BOTH VERSIONS NOT ENOUGH CRASHES MAKES THIS PROBLEM EASIER TO HANDLE_

 **NBTExplorer Link Here 👇**

[NBTExplorer Github Download Page](https://github.com/jaquadro/NBTExplorer)
